source: Excel 365's Rules Manager, Edit Rule used in its own window on the middle of three rules (A1:A10: Cell Value > 8, Cell Value < 3 with Stop If True off, Formula =A1=5), its value changed and OK twice; the rules read over COM, 15 November 2026
note: The edited rule keeps its priority, its Stop If True and its format, unlike COM's FormatCondition.Modify, which sends it last and sets Stop If True.
